info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Ecommerce Cart Checkouts-v3-spec
info.description: The Ecommerce Cart Checkout List API allows users to retrieve a list of checkouts for their ecommerce cart. This endpoint is designed for retailers and developers working with ecommerce platforms, enabling them to monitor cart activity and analyze checkout patterns. Consumers typically include frontend applications that display cart statistics, as well as backend services that require access to checkout data for reporting or analytics. By leveraging this API, businesses can enhance their understanding of customer behavior and optimize their sales strategies.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to proceed to checkout with the items in their shopping cart, confirming their order and initiating the payment process.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to initiate the checkout process for the items contained in the shopping cart. It should provide all necessary details for processing the checkout, ensuring that the transaction can proceed smoothly without any missing information.

ListEcommerceCartCheckoutsRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation of the cart checkout endpoint.

ListEcommerceCartCheckoutsResponse_200.title: Checkout Response

status.description: Indicates whether the checkout operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number for the checkout transaction.

resultId.description: A unique identifier for the result of the checkout operation.

state.description: The current state of the checkout process.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the checkout operation in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the checkout operation.

ListEcommerceCartCheckoutsResponse_200.description: Response schema for the checkout operation, indicating the success status and providing additional context about the transaction.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The email or identifier of the user who initiated the checkout operation.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the checkout operation was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the checkout operation was performed automatically by the system.

AuditInfo.description: Contains information about the audit trail for the checkout operation.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the time taken to process the request in milliseconds.
